SELECT toUInt32(uniqExact(if(SpanAttributes['enduser.id'] != '', SpanAttributes['enduser.id'], if(SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] = 'org_api_key', SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.api_key.id'], '')))) AS DAU
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE Timestamp >= toDateTime64(toDate($__toTime), 3)
  AND Timestamp <= $__toTime_ms
  AND $__filters
  AND ServiceName = 'backend'
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] NOT IN ('webhook', 'job')
  AND (SpanAttributes['enduser.id'] != '' OR (SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] = 'org_api_key' AND SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.api_key.id'] != ''))

SELECT toUInt32(uniqExact(if(SpanAttributes['enduser.id'] != '', SpanAttributes['enduser.id'], if(SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] = 'org_api_key', SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.api_key.id'], '')))) AS WAU
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE Timestamp >= toDateTime64(toDate($__toTime) - 6, 3)
  AND Timestamp <= $__toTime_ms
  AND $__filters
  AND ServiceName = 'backend'
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] NOT IN ('webhook', 'job')
  AND (SpanAttributes['enduser.id'] != '' OR (SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] = 'org_api_key' AND SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.api_key.id'] != ''))

SELECT toUInt32(uniqExact(if(SpanAttributes['enduser.id'] != '', SpanAttributes['enduser.id'], if(SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] = 'org_api_key', SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.api_key.id'], '')))) AS MAU
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE Timestamp >= toDateTime64(toDate($__toTime) - 29, 3)
  AND Timestamp <= $__toTime_ms
  AND $__filters
  AND ServiceName = 'backend'
  AND SpanKind = 'Server'
  AND SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] NOT IN ('webhook', 'job')
  AND (SpanAttributes['enduser.id'] != '' OR (SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] = 'org_api_key' AND SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.api_key.id'] != ''))

WITH
  $__fromTime AS range_start,
  $__toTime AS range_end,
  toDate(range_start) AS chart_start,
  toDate(range_end) AS chart_end,
  chart_start - 30 AS lookback_start,
  (
    SELECT uniqExactState(actor_id)
    FROM (SELECT '' AS actor_id WHERE 0)
  ) AS empty_state
SELECT ts, DAU, WAU, MAU
FROM (
  SELECT
    toDateTime(day) AS ts,
    day,
    toUInt32(finalizeAggregation(user_state)) AS DAU,
    toUInt32(uniqExactMerge(user_state) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS WAU,
    toUInt32(uniqExactMerge(user_state) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS MAU
  FROM (
    SELECT
      calendar.day AS day,
      if(isNull(active.day), empty_state, active.user_state) AS user_state
    FROM (
      SELECT lookback_start + number AS day
      FROM numbers(421)
      WHERE number <= toUInt64(greatest(dateDiff('day', lookback_start, chart_end), 0))
    ) AS calendar
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        toDate(Timestamp) AS day,
        uniqExactState(if(SpanAttributes['enduser.id'] != '', SpanAttributes['enduser.id'], if(SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] = 'org_api_key', SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.api_key.id'], ''))) AS user_state
      FROM otel.otel_traces
      WHERE Timestamp >= toDateTime64(lookback_start, 3)
        AND Timestamp <= $__toTime_ms
        AND $__filters
        AND ServiceName = 'backend'
        AND SpanKind = 'Server'
        AND SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] NOT IN ('webhook', 'job')
        AND (SpanAttributes['enduser.id'] != '' OR (SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] = 'org_api_key' AND SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.api_key.id'] != ''))
      GROUP BY day
    ) AS active ON active.day = calendar.day
  )
)
WHERE day >= chart_start AND day <= chart_end
ORDER BY ts

WITH
  $__fromTime AS range_start,
  $__toTime AS range_end,
  toDate(range_start) AS chart_start,
  toDate(range_end) AS chart_end,
  chart_start - 30 AS lookback_start,
  (
    SELECT uniqExactState(actor_id)
    FROM (SELECT '' AS actor_id WHERE 0)
  ) AS empty_state
SELECT ts, DAU, WAU, MAU
FROM (
  SELECT
    toDateTime(day) AS ts,
    day,
    toUInt32(finalizeAggregation(user_state)) AS DAU,
    toUInt32(uniqExactMerge(user_state) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS WAU,
    toUInt32(uniqExactMerge(user_state) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS MAU
  FROM (
    SELECT
      calendar.day AS day,
      if(isNull(active.day), empty_state, active.user_state) AS user_state
    FROM (
      SELECT lookback_start + number AS day
      FROM numbers(421)
      WHERE number <= toUInt64(greatest(dateDiff('day', lookback_start, chart_end), 0))
    ) AS calendar
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        toDate(Timestamp) AS day,
        uniqExactState(if(SpanAttributes['enduser.id'] != '', SpanAttributes['enduser.id'], if(SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] = 'org_api_key', SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.api_key.id'], ''))) AS user_state
      FROM otel.otel_traces
      WHERE Timestamp >= toDateTime64(lookback_start, 3)
        AND Timestamp <= $__toTime_ms
        AND $__filters
        AND ServiceName = 'backend'
        AND SpanKind = 'Server'
        AND (SpanName = 'POST /mcp' OR SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.mcp.tool'] != '')
        AND SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] NOT IN ('webhook', 'job')
        AND (SpanAttributes['enduser.id'] != '' OR (SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] = 'org_api_key' AND SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.api_key.id'] != ''))
      GROUP BY day
    ) AS active ON active.day = calendar.day
  )
)
WHERE day >= chart_start AND day <= chart_end
ORDER BY ts

WITH
  toDate($__fromTime) AS range_start_day,
  toDate($__toTime) AS end_day,
  if(dateDiff('day', range_start_day, end_day) + 1 > 30, end_day - 29, range_start_day) AS start_day
SELECT
  concat(leftPad(toString(buckets.bucket), 2, '0'), if(buckets.bucket = 1, ' day', ' days')) AS active_days,
  toUInt32(ifNull(counts.users, 0)) AS users
FROM (
  SELECT toUInt8(number + 1) AS bucket
  FROM numbers(30)
  WHERE number < toUInt64(dateDiff('day', start_day, end_day) + 1)
) AS buckets
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT active_days, toUInt32(count()) AS users
  FROM (
    SELECT uniqExact(toDate(Timestamp)) AS active_days
    FROM otel.otel_traces
    WHERE Timestamp >= toDateTime64(start_day, 3)
      AND Timestamp <= $__toTime_ms
      AND $__filters
      AND ServiceName = 'backend'
      AND SpanKind = 'Server'
      AND SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] NOT IN ('webhook', 'job')
      AND (SpanAttributes['enduser.id'] != '' OR (SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] = 'org_api_key' AND SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.api_key.id'] != ''))
    GROUP BY if(SpanAttributes['enduser.id'] != '', SpanAttributes['enduser.id'], if(SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.actor.type'] = 'org_api_key', SpanAttributes['ctxpipe.api_key.id'], ''))
  )
  GROUP BY active_days
) AS counts ON counts.active_days = buckets.bucket
ORDER BY buckets.bucket
